//: This is the LANDING project -> easyanalysis-landing-page.vercel.app
In the Vercel dashboard set this project's Root Directory to `landing`,
so this file is the one Vercel reads. The site is plain static HTML/CSS —
no build step, no dependencies, no CDN.
The install one-liners shown on the site point at easyanalysis.vercel.app
(the APP project), which serves install.ps1 / install.sh.
